# Proto reference

Every service, message tag and enum value deshred serves, straight out of the shipped
`.proto` files in [../proto/](../proto/). This page is the mechanical index: what a field
is *called*, what number it carries and what type it has. What a field **means** — and
what an absent one implies — is [data-model.md](data-model.md).

Tag numbers are a contract: within `deshred.v1` they are never renumbered, retyped or
repurposed, and a breaking change gets a new package. See
[../proto/deshred-v1/README.md](../proto/deshred-v1/README.md).

## Services

| Service | RPC | Request | Response | Kind | Mounted by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shredstream.Shredstream` | `SendHeartbeat` | `Heartbeat` | `HeartbeatResponse` | unary | **not served** — vendored upstream definition, deshred registers no such service |
| `shredstream.ShredstreamProxy` | `SubscribeEntries` | `SubscribeEntriesRequest` | `Entry` | server-stream | always on |
| `deshred.v1.SignalStream` | `SubscribeTxSignals` | `SubscribeTxSignalsRequest` | `TxSignal` | server-stream | `SHRED_GRPC_SIGNALS=true` |
| `deshred.v1.SignalStream` | `SubscribeSlotSignals` | `SubscribeSlotSignalsRequest` | `SlotSignal` | server-stream | `SHRED_GRPC_SIGNALS=true` |
| `deshred.v1.SwapIntentStream` | `SubscribeSwapIntents` | `SubscribeSwapIntentsRequest` | `SwapIntentSignal` | server-stream | `SHRED_GRPC_SIGNALS=true` **and** `SHRED_DECODE_INTENTS=true` |
| `deshred.v1.SwapIntentStream` | `SubscribeSwapIntentChains` | `SubscribeSwapIntentChainsRequest` | `SwapIntentChain` | server-stream | `SHRED_GRPC_SIGNALS=true` **and** `SHRED_DECODE_INTENTS=true` |
| `deshred.v1.RouteStream` | `SubscribeRoutes` | `SubscribeRoutesRequest` | `RouteSignal` | server-stream | `SHRED_GRPC_SIGNALS=true` **and** `SHRED_DECODE_INTENTS=true` |

Every request message is empty: there are no server-side filters, every subscriber
receives the same stream, and filtering is client-side.

## Enums

Every enum's `0` is an `_UNSPECIFIED` that the server never sends, so an older client
reading a variant it does not know fails closed instead of mistaking it for a real value.
**One documented exception:** `RouteSignal.mode` does send `SWAP_MODE_UNSPECIFIED` when a
route plan's mode could not be determined; `plan_stand_down` carries the reason.
